issue.title: Bug:bmp/test_docker_restart.py::test_restart_bmp_docker fails  because the test attempts to restart bmp.service, but BMP is not enabled in the image.

failure.body:
### Is it platform specific

generic

### Importance or Severity

Medium

### Description of the bug

bmp/test_docker_restart.py::test_restart_bmp_docker expects the BMP
  service/container to exist and be restartable.

  On 202605 images, BMP is built into the image with INCLUDE_SYSTEM_BMP=y,
  but bmp is not added to the generated FEATURE table in
  files/build_templates/init_cfg.json.j2. As a result, bmp.service is
  masked and the bmp container is absent.

  BMP was previously disabled due to FRR/BMP performance issues:
  https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-buildimage/issues/23777

  That performance issue was fixed by:
  https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-buildimage/pull/23958

### Steps to Reproduce

1.  Install a SONiC image where INCLUDE_SYSTEM_BMP=y.
2.   Run:  `docker inspect -f '{{.State.Running}}' bmp`
3.    Try to start/restart BMP:  `sudo systemctl start bmp`
        Or run:   `bmp/test_docker_restart.py::test_restart_bmp_docker`

### Actual Behavior and Expected Behavior

**Actual behavior:**
  The bmp container does not exist and bmp.service is masked.

  **Expected behavior:**
  When INCLUDE_SYSTEM_BMP=y, the generated image config should include bmp
  in the FEATURE table so bmp.service and the bmp container are available.
  The BMP docker restart test should be able to restart the service.

### Relevant log output

```shell
docker inspect -f {{.State.Running}} bmp
Error: No such object: bmp

sudo systemctl start bmp
Failed to start bmp.service: Unit bmp.service is masked.
```

resolution.title: Restore BMP golden config
resolution.description:
### Description of PR

Summary:

Restore the version-gated BMP golden-config enablement path

PR #24625 disabled BMP tests on master because of sonic-buildimage issue
#23777. That issue has since been fixed, so sonic-mgmt can again enable BMP
through golden config for supported images without enabling BMP by default in
production images.

Fixes #26162

### Approach
#### What is the motivation for this PR?

BMP was disabled in sonic-mgmt as a temporary gate for sonic-buildimage issue
#23777. That issue has been fixed, so the blanket master skip can be removed.

The fix keeps BMP disabled by default in production images, while allowing the
 sonic-mgmt golden-config flow to enable BMP for supported test images.

#### How did you do it?
Restored the version-gated `check_version_for_bmp()` logic in
  `generate_golden_config_db.py`.

Changed the `bmp/` conditional mark from a blanket master skip to a BMC-only
  skip.

#### How did you verify/test it?

On 202605, verified after deploy-mg: BMP enabled through golden config and bmp tests passed.
